question: How does divine maya become crossable?
premises: divine maya is hard to cross
resorting to the Lord crosses it
knowing supreme Brahman sees the world undivided
inference: Maya is crossed by resort to the Lord and by undivided knowing.
uncertainties: fused compounds retain unresolved internal sandhi
plain_english: Divine maya is hard to cross, yet those who resort to the Lord cross it; knowing supreme Brahman sees the world undivided.
